name: Nomifactory-CEu
description: Nomifactory CEu Modded Minecraft Server Nomifactory CEu Fork of Nomifactory, using Gregtech CEu and its related mods. Version tags available: - 1.7.7 - 1.7.6 - 1.7.5 - 1.7.4 - 1.7.3 - 1.7.2 - 1.7.1 - 1.7-beta-6 - 1.7-beta-5 - 1.7-alpha-4 - 1.7-alpha-3 - 1.7-alpha-2 - 1.7-alpha-1 - 1.7 - 1.6.1b - 1.6.1a - 1.6.1-beta-4 Setup: [li]You must accept the EULA by setting the EULA variable to true or the install will fail. Optional: [li]You can setup a comma separated list of players who will have admin privileges in game by setting OPS
